prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM. Spacious, stylish living room of an heiress's luxury apartment. A cream bouclé sofa with pastel cushions faces a low glass coffee table on a soft pale rug. A doorway at the back opens to the kitchen. Bright daylight falls from large windows on the left, and warm floor lamps glow softly at the sofa's ends.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
